description: Westfield Century City is a massive, 120,000-square-metre shopping mall – a must-see metropolis of Los Angeles opulence. It's not just that this mall has over 200 stores Beverly Center / The Grove | Neighborhood Guide, but it represents the ultimate destination for luxury shopping in LA. This upscale mall features high-end retailers, fine dining, and entertainment options in a modern, sophisticated setting.
name: Westfield Century City
